title: under masked, a secret that is itself an allow-listed ordinary word is still echoed
evidence: allowlistTitle('Weekly sync') === 'Weekly sync'; if an organiser's passcode is literally 'sync' with no keyword, it is shown. Residual by construction of any allow-list: it cannot tell a title word from a passcode that equals one. The list is ~100 lower-case ASCII words, no numbers, names, colours or animals.
fix_direction: None needed for the default omit policy. masked stays gated by contract W8 (Approver acceptance). Keep the list short; do not grow it for utility without a decision.
